messages:
Iris (docs): Quick PR opened to clarify supported regions table and add a short Brazil + HK data residency footnote. Also updated SDK snippets to show region selection. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2235

Sam (i18n): Looks good overall. Small wording: use 'data residency options may be available' instead of definitive language. I can provide 1-line pt-BR and zh-HK footnotes.

Diego (SDK): Current example used `X-Region`. Change to `X-Redwood-Region`. Also demonstrate client-level region via env var. Suggested tiny snippet:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ region: process.env.REDWOOD_REGION })
await client.generate({ prompt: 'Hello' })
// per-request header (hosted/private)
fetch('/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-west-1' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt }) })
```

Priya (legal): Don't imply guarantees. Recommend: "Data residency options are available in select regions; customers should consult their contract or account team for specifics and audit options." Add links to Private deployments and SLA.

Iris (docs): Thanks — switching header, adding env var snippet, and using Priya's phrasing. Sam, please paste the one-line localized footnotes here and I'll include them.

Sam (i18n): PT-BR: "Op
Opes de residncia de dados esto disponveis em regies selecionadas; consulte seu contrato ou equipe de conta para detalhes."

Diego (SDK): One more accuracy note: Dedicated capacity ignores per-request region header; add parenthetical: "(Note: Dedicated capacity customers should use their account-configured pool; per-request region header applies to Hosted and Private control-plane routing.)"

Iris (docs): Added parenthetical, links, and the env var snippet. Build preview: https://deploy-preview-redwood-docs.netlify.app/pr-2235/regions.html

Priya (legal): LGTM after the SLA link is correct.
